an6.71:1.1: This is a reference to the six cognitive skills. See AN 5:28.
an6.71:1.3: A quality with a share in decline is one that causes the mind to fall from concentration. A quality with a share in stability is one that helps to maintain concentration. A quality with a share in distinction is one that leads to higher stages of concentration. A quality with a share in penetration is one leading to liberating insight. See AN 4:179.
